company_name: AMFLO Fluid Systems & Components Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — AMFLO specializes in precision gas supply systems critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: AMFLO Fluid Systems & Components Co., Ltd. is a leading provider of precision gas supply systems, focusing on high-purity gas components essential for semiconductor applications. With nearly 20 years of experience, the company offers products like regulators, valves, and fittings that ensure reliability and performance in gas handling for the semiconductor industry.
capabilities: complete gas line systems for high-purity process gases

regional_presence.China: AMFLO is based in Shanghai's Songjiang District and operates an intelligent factory with high-grade clean rooms.
